## ST201 - Data Analysis

### ~~Office~~ Student Hours

**Student hours** are set times dedicated to all of you. Most professors call
these *"office hours"* - which I always found too formal and scary!

::: {.callout-warning title="Why student hours?"}
Students often think that *"office hours"* are times when [professors should be
left alone](https://www.chronicle.com/article/can-this-man-change-how-elite-colleges-treat-low-income-students/) - **which is the total opposite**.
I'm hoping that by calling them student hours, it might alleviate this
misunderstanding.
:::

This means that during these times I'll be waiting for you to talk to me where
you can ask whatever questions you may have.

You can [schedule a meeting with me here](https://calendly.com/cormac-monaghan-mu).

[**Or just knock on the door and pop in!**]{.center}

## ST201 - Data Analysis

### Lecture format

- All the **slides** and **reference material** will be uploaded to a
  [dedicated module website](https://c-monaghan.github.io/ST201/)
- I will also add them to **Moodle**.
- Some lectures will focus on slides and class materials, while others will
  involve **R coding sessions using RStudio**.
- Just like the slides, all the R code will be provided to help you along
  with your learning.

::: {.callout-note title="If you have questions"}
**Please stop me at any point** to ask a question or ask me to clarify something.
Alternatively, if you're a shy person (like me!) you can come up and ask me at
the end of class!
:::

## ST201 - Data Analysis

### What we will cover

This modules aims to introduce you to the **fundamentals of data analysis using R.**
This course will cover (but is not limited to) the following topics:

- Numerical and graphical data summaries
- Measures of central tendency
- Association of two or more variables
- Correlation
- Regression
